idea-plugin.name: Local Secrets Tripwire
idea-plugin.description:
Local Secrets Tripwire — Real-Time Secret Detection for Your IDE

Leaked secrets are the #1 cause of security breaches. Local Secrets Tripwire scans your files in real time for API keys, tokens, passwords, and private keys — catching them before they are committed to version control. All scanning happens locally. Zero data leaves your machine.

Detection Engine

  • 42 built-in patterns: AWS (incl. temporary keys), GitHub (classic, fine-grained, OAuth, refresh), OpenAI, Anthropic, GitLab, npm, PyPI, Hugging Face, Slack (bot/user/app tokens, webhooks), Stripe (keys and webhook secrets), Twilio, Telegram, DigitalOcean, Shopify, Databricks, Atlassian, Doppler, HashiCorp Vault, Azure Storage, Mailchimp, Firebase, Google, SendGrid, JWTs, private keys (RSA/EC/DSA/OpenSSH/PGP), connection strings, credentials in URLs, Bearer headers, and more
  • Shannon entropy analysis for high-randomness strings (opt-in, configurable threshold)
  • Custom regex patterns for organization-specific secrets
  • Overlapping matches are deduplicated to the most severe finding
  • Runs as a standard IntelliJ code inspection in the Security group

Editor Integration

  • Severity-aware inline highlighting of the exact secret range
  • Quick fixes: add to allowlist or suppress with an inline tripwire:ignore comment
  • Masked display of detected values for safety — the raw secret is never shown

Configuration

  • Allowlist support via .secrets-allowlist file for false positive suppression
  • Inline suppression with tripwire:ignore comments
  • Configurable entropy threshold (default 4.5)
  • Custom pattern table with name, regex, severity, and enable toggle

Git Integration

  • Pre-commit guard — scans staged files and shows the findings (masked) with a Commit Anyway / Cancel choice
  • Respects the allowlist, custom patterns, and inline suppressions
  • Git history scan for previously leaked secrets

Requirements

  • IntelliJ IDEA 2024.3+ (or any JetBrains IDE based on IntelliJ Platform)
  • Java 17+
  • Git4Idea plugin (optional, for Git integration features)

Support

  • GitHub: github.com/JirakJ/local-secrets-tripwire
  • Issues: Report a Bug
  • Author: Jakub Jirák
idea-plugin.change-notes:
2026.8.0

  • The plugin is now completely free — all features unlocked, no license needed.
  • Source code is now open source under Apache-2.0: https://github.com/JirakJ/local-secrets-tripwire

2026.4.0

  • NEW: 42 detection patterns (up from 15) - OpenAI, Anthropic, GitLab, npm, PyPI, Hugging Face, Slack webhooks, Twilio, Telegram, DigitalOcean, Shopify, Databricks, Atlassian, Doppler, Vault, Azure Storage, Mailchimp, Firebase, credentials in URLs, Bearer headers, PGP keys, and more
  • NEW: Quick fixes - Add a finding to the allowlist or suppress it with an inline tripwire:ignore comment, right from the inspection popup
  • NEW: Inline suppression - A tripwire:ignore comment silences findings on that line in the editor and the pre-commit guard
  • NEW: Severity-aware highlighting - The exact secret range is underlined with the pattern's severity, not just the first token of the line
  • NEW: Pre-commit dialog - The guard now shows the findings (masked) with a Commit Anyway / Cancel choice instead of cancelling silently
  • FIX: Entropy detection is wired into the inspection - the threshold setting previously had no effect; detection is now an opt-in toggle
  • FIX: Pre-commit guard respects the allowlist, custom patterns, and the plugin enable toggle
  • FIX: Settings table no longer loses pattern type and description on save
  • FIX: Git history audit records real commit dates
  • FIX: Overlapping matches are deduplicated to the most severe finding
